name: Mittal Life Style Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2005, Mittal Lifestyle Ltd supplies Bottom weight Fabrics & Denims[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
Company has one of the range of denim fabrics in India with ~200+ regular sorts stocked.  It provides different types and quality of denim fabric. Company procures denim fabric primarily from Ahmedabad and sells the same in Mumbai and Ulhasnagar. Company also caters to big brands like future retail ltd and fashion brand like myntra

pros: Stock is trading at 0.92 times its book value
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.02 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -11.0%
